name: Request Handling 2
definition: Explains the status of the related request.

StatusCode.name: Status Code
StatusCode.definition: Specifies the status of the request, for example the result of the schema validation or a business processing result/error.

StatusDateTime.name: Status Date Time
StatusDateTime.definition: Date and time when the status was generated.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Description of the status, in free format text.
